thread:
alex: Heads-up: postmortem action INF-3600 (rotate-serving-certs + post-check) is still open and past due. Assigned to @khadija with due 2026-03-21. Need status and plan.

khadija: Still blocked by HSM provisioning delays from procurement. Opened escalation with procurement lead yesterday. No firm ETA.

alex: This is the 4th time cert rotation items have lagged after an incident. Can we set an interim owner if procurement doesn't respond in 48h? Also we should add an expiry alert so we don't hit this blind.

tom: I can take interim ownership if procurement stalls. Suggest adding alert: cert_expiry_warning (<=14d) and a quarterly cert audit. I'll draft the rule.

khadija: Thanks @tom. I'll update INF-3600 with the procurement thread and confirm by EOD whether I can proceed. If no, assign to @tom and set new due 2026-03-28.

opsbot: INF-3600 linked to PM-2026-03. Reminder scheduled: INF-3600 follow-up in 48h.

alex: Please keep action tracker updated. We need stricter SLAs on postmortem remediations that depend on third parties.

khadija: Will do. Adding notes about workaround (use cached certs for <72h window) to the ticket.

tom: I'll prepare the alert PR and the runbook snippet for cached-cert fallback.

alex: Great, thanks — tag me when the PR is up.
